profile_text.body:
Duolingo is a publicly traded company, listed under the ticker DUOL, that describes itself on its website as the world's most popular way to learn a language. The company says its service is 100 percent free, fun, and science-based, and that users can practice online at duolingo.com or through its apps. It presents language learning as a game and states that the approach is scientifically proven to work.

Its tracked AI product is Duolingo for Schools, which the company offers free of charge at schools.duolingo.com. The product is described as using AI for adaptive assignments and is aimed at students and teachers. For users under 13, restrictions apply: no public profile, leaderboards, forums, or social logins, and non-personalized ads for those under 16. No signed California Student Data Privacy Agreement is recorded for the product per a K-12 data leadership directory.

The company is a for-profit public company. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it.
